serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
You: Bye…
That…{{wi}} was unexpected.
Everything she said made perfect sense, but I can’t shake off some uneasiness…
Will she really be alright? Was she telling the truth? I don’t know.
One thing I’m sure of is that Melissa doesn’t seem to me like a cold-blooded murderer. I will trust my gut.
Ah! The batteries! I need to get going before shops close!
